headline: BGE PSC Pinsky
summary: BGE's requested 10.4% profit for next year has sparked public outrage, with residents criticizing the company's monopoly and guaranteed profits at their expense.

headline: ICE recently arrested at least 9 people in Vermont as the agency appears to ramp up immigration enforcement across the state
summary: ICE arrested at least nine people across Vermont over a weekend, including workers heading to job sites. Advocates raise concerns about increased federal enforcement and possible racial profiling. ACLU files claims against ICE for constitutional violations following March raid. ICE operations lack transparency due to lack of centralized tracking system in Vermont. Local law enforcement adheres to state policy limiting assistance in federal immigration enforcement.

headline: U.S. House candidate Bohannan commits to spend more on cancer research
summary: Iowa City Democrat Christina Bohannan, running for U.S. House, discussed cancer concerns at an American Cancer Society event. Iowa has the fastest-rising cancer rate and expects 21,700 new cases this year. Bohannan criticized opponent Rep. Miller-Meeks for voting on a bill that could leave millions without health insurance by 2034. She supports increased research funding and smoking cessation programs, noting rural residents' challenges accessing healthcare and cancer trials. Agricultural chemicals' role in rising cancer rates was discussed.
